tasks.title: Add RateLimitConfig to Policy Rule and EvalResult (R3)
tasks.description: Extend policy configuration and evaluation to support rate limiting per rule
tasks.details:
1. Add to `src/policy/config.rs`:
```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize, Serialize)]
pub struct RateLimitConfig { pub max_requests: u64, pub window_secs: u64 }

pub struct Rule { /* ... */ #[serde(default)] pub rate_limit: Option<RateLimitConfig>, }
```
2. Extend EvalResult with `pub rate_limit: Option<RateLimitConfig>`
3. Update policy deserialization and evaluation to propagate rate_limit config.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for TOML parsing with/without rate_limit, policy evaluation returns correct RateLimitConfig.
